name: vellum-marketing
_name_note: Not a typo and not a survivor of a lazy sweep. This is a private, unpublished npm identifier that nothing reads: no script, no workflow and no import resolves it, and package-lock.json is gitignored. It kept the Vellum name through the Aug 27 2026 Pocket Chronicle rename for the same reason the repository is still called Rascal-Marketing — an internal identifier that changes costs more than it buys. Leave it; the product name lives in site.config.json PRODUCT.
